cards.text: Jesus is still giving John letters for seven churches, and John is writing them down (Revelation 1:11, 17-19). This one goes to the angel of the church in Pergamum, from the One who holds the sharp, double-edged sword. Friend, the only letter I ever wrote was on the back of a takeout menu, and it did NOT open like that.
First, Jesus says He knows where they live. And friend, it is NOT the kind of neighborhood you brag about in the group chat.

cards.question: What does Jesus say sits right there in Pergamum?
Living right where Satan's throne sits, the church in Pergamum has denied its faith in Jesus.

cards.text: They held on even in the days of a man Jesus calls "My faithful witness Antipas". Jesus knows his name. Let that sit for a second.

cards.question: What happened to Antipas, Jesus' faithful witness, in Pergamum?

answers.text: He was driven out of town

cards.text: Uh oh, here comes the turn. Jesus has a few things against them, because some of them hold to the teaching of Balaam, the man Balak, king of Moab, once sent for to curse Israel (Numbers 22:4-6).

cards.question: Jesus says Balaam taught Balak to place a stumbling block before the Israelites. What was it meant to lead them into?

answers.text: Worship of the sun and moon

cards.question: Balaam's teaching is the only wrong teaching Jesus calls out in Pergamum.

cards.text: Some of them also hold to the teaching of the Nicolaitans, the same group Ephesus got credit for hating (Revelation 2:6). Friend, I once burned two batches in one morning, and the smoke alarm stopped calling it an accident.

cards.question: So what does Jesus tell Pergamum to do? One word: ___!
If Pergamum doesn't repent, Jesus says He'll come shortly and wage war. With what?

cards.text: Then the line every letter has had so far (Revelation 2:7, 11): "He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches." I checked, friend. That means you.

cards.question: Jesus makes a promise to the one who overcomes in Pergamum, and it starts with food. What is it?

answers.text: Fruit from the tree of life

cards.question: Jesus also promises the one who overcomes a white stone with a new ___ written on it.
The new name on the white stone is known to everyone in the church.

cards.text: Next letter goes to the angel of the church in Thyatira. This time Jesus calls Himself the Son of God, whose eyes are like a blazing fire and whose feet are like polished bronze.

cards.question: Jesus knows Thyatira's love, faith, service and perseverance. Their latest deeds are ___ than their first.

cards.text: And you knew it was coming, friend: Jesus has something against them. They tolerate a woman He calls Jezebel, and she calls herself a prophetess.

cards.question: Jezebel's teaching misleads Jesus' servants into the same two sins Balaam's stumbling block was meant to lead the Israelites into.

cards.text: Jesus says He gave her time to repent of her immorality. Friend, when they moved me to the junk drawer, I didn't even get a two-week notice.

cards.question: Jesus gave Jezebel time to repent. What does she do with it?
Jesus says He'll cast Jezebel onto a bed of sickness. What does He say about those who commit adultery with her?

answers.text: A bed of sickness beside her

cards.text: Then Jesus says He will strike her children dead. And He says all the churches will know something from it.

cards.question: What will all the churches know about Jesus?

cards.text: He also says, "I will repay each of you according to your deeds." Then He turns to the rest of Thyatira, the ones who don't hold to her teaching and haven't learned the so-called "deep things of Satan".

cards.question: Jesus tells the rest of Thyatira that He'll place more burdens on them.
No further burden for the rest of Thyatira, except one: hold fast to what they have until Jesus ___.

cards.text: Hold fast? Friend, this mustache was BUILT for holding. Now Jesus makes a promise to the one who overcomes and keeps on in His work until the end.

cards.question: Jesus promises the one who overcomes in Thyatira authority. Over what?

cards.text: The one who overcomes will rule the nations with an iron scepter and shatter them like pottery. That's authority nobody argues with, friend.

cards.question: Jesus says that authority is just like the authority He received from His ___.

cards.text: And one last gift for the one who overcomes: Jesus says He will give him the morning star. Berry would LOVE that one.
Then that line again: "He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches." Four letters down, friend, and Jesus isn't done writing yet.

findings.problem: The joke doesn't share the fact's core action. In verse 15, a second group holds a second teaching. Burning two batches in one morning is one person repeating a mistake. The image of a smoke alarm that 'stopped calling it an accident' also doesn't click instantly, so a stranger would likely say 'huh?'.

rule.text: The everyday comparison must have the same action.

findings.problem: The baker has to guess a detail of the prophetic wording: hidden manna, the bread of the Presence or fruit from the tree of life. No earlier card lets them reason toward hidden manna. This is the same pattern as the Psalm 23 bad example, 'What does He anoint David's head with?'

rule.text: Ask about the movement and the meaning: what changes, what the picture is, why the speaker says what he says.

findings.problem: The blank asks the baker to guess the wording of the inscription (name, song or covenant) with no setup to reason from. It tests wording they haven't seen, not meaning.

rule.text: The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.

findings.problem: 'A woman He calls Jezebel' suggests Jezebel is a label Jesus gives her rather than her name. Verse 20 says 'that woman Jezebel' and leaves this open.

rule.text: Leave open what the text leaves open.

findings.problem: The right answer 'Father' is capitalized and the wrong answers 'prophets' and 'people' are lowercase, so the capital letter gives the answer away.

rule.text: Don't let the right answer stand out. All the answers should sound alike.

findings.problem: 'Jesus isn't done writing yet' says Jesus is the one writing. In the text, Jesus tells John to write ('write' in Revelation 2:12, 18), and stop 1 card 1 says John is writing them down.

rule.text: Call things what the text calls them.
